detailed_descriptions.en: In the wake of the Tempest Wars, the Veti lie shattered. Hunted by mankind’s warring factions across a world they once ruled, they scrape together what remains, restoring forces and rebuilding doctrine toward a single, absolute purpose: Reclamation. K’uhul the Immutable watches through the cracks of his prison. An ancient Veti ruler entombed for devouring colony worlds across the stars, his acrid words seep through the scattered ranks of his own kind. If the reclamation fails, it will not be at human hands. Experience the final chapter of Tempest Rising: lead the shattered Veti through a full-fledged 11-mission campaign to reunite your forces, reclaim stolen technology, and excise the corruption threatening to subsume your people from within. The Veti do not waste their enemies. Convert fallen soldiers into the mindless Enlightened, then sacrifice them mid-battle to fuel your machines and empower your warriors. Master a full suite of new infantry, abilities, and doctrines built around total domination of the unworthy. Every weapon in the Veti arsenal is designed to remind the humans of their place. From the colossal War Ender to the veiled Phantom Artillery, command a roster of devastating units. Deploy teleportation tactics, consume units on command for surges of power, and unleash the full might of a civilization older than human memory. Ascension Anchors are at the heart of every Veti base: sacrificial obelisks that ascend through tiers of power by consuming the Enlightened. Each tier extends new tethers to your surrounding structures, enhancing everything they touch. Choose where your power flows as the battlefield shifts.
